description:
Implement the one predeclared consumer-specific dispatch experiment and compare it with the current public-call path.

## Background

The experiment targets a measured unhoisted consumer and must have a materially different call contract from the preserved 64-word generic-hoist no-win. Already-hoisted M4RM, RREF, Gauss, Strassen, and degenerate multiply loops remain controls, not migration targets.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The candidate is bounded to the profile-identified unhoisted consumer and has shared semantic coverage across selected worker counts, fallbacks, offset views, and boundary sizes.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipt reports dispatch-inclusive whole-consumer samples, adjusted confidence bounds, equivalence results, complexity accounting, assembly, and profile attribution.
- [hard] REQ-03: The 64-word generic-hoist no-win remains unchanged, no production helper lands in this issue, and negative evidence is retained.

## Notes

The experiment may bind an existing resolver privately; it must not introduce a parallel dispatch authority.
title: Measure the consumer-specific dispatch candidate
